newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi British Bank net profit up 15.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Saudi British Bank net profit up 15.3 pct.

text.p: Full Name: The Saudi British Bank
NOTE: The Riyadh-based bank is 40 percent owned by HSBC Holding. The rest is held by Saudi Arabian investors.
The Board of Governors has recommended a net dividend of 27 riyals per share.
The bank said in a statement that competitive market strategies, coupled with improved liquidity in the Saudi economy, had led to an increase in the deposit base of 15 percent to 21.3 billion riyals.
But it said lower levels of economic activity had led to a slight fall in loans and advances to customers to 10.3 billion riyals in 1996 from 10.6 billion in 1995.

The bank said that in order to utilise the surplus liquidity, it had built up its investment portfolio to 15.2 billion riyals in 1996 from 9.1 billion the previous year. The investments were primarily in Saudi Government Development Bonds, contractors bonds and agricultural certificates.
